boot.evidence: the CI-built kernel+stub pair boots the Debian 12 + Docker image to its docker-init marker with seccomp=on and 4 vCPU; 27 RESULT lines collected from the in-guest capability matrix (cap8-boot1.log)

cgroup_controllers.evidence: cgroup.controllers = cpuset cpu io memory pids (released kernels exposed only cpu io memory pids); enabling +cpu +memory +pids in cgroup.subtree_control succeeds

config_gaps_closed.evidence: /proc/config.gz inside the guest shows CONFIG_CPUSETS=y, CONFIG_BLK_CGROUP=y, CONFIG_BLK_DEV_THROTTLING=y, CONFIG_MODULES=y -- all four absent in every released kernel; the docker daemon no longer reports its cpuset warning (docker_cpuset_warning=no)

docker.evidence: dockerd starts (SERVER=20.10.24+dfsg1 DRIVER=overlay2 CGROUPV=2), a fresh busybox pull through gvproxy NAT/DNS runs (BUSYBOX_RUN_OK), and an inbound published port is reachable from the phone's loopback (curl 127.0.0.1:8123 -> gvproxy-bess-ok) in the same boot (docker-full.log)

memcg_kmem_absent.evidence: CONFIG_MEMCG_KMEM is still absent in the built config, so tmpfs/page cache stays uncharged (memory.current unchanged after an 80 MB tmpfs write inside a 64 MB group) -- carried over from the released kernel, not a regression; next candidate symbol for the CI config

stub_toolchain_parity.evidence: the CI stub built with NDK r29 is byte-identical (sha256 731c48d5...) to the released stub_exe; the earlier r27c stub lacked .rela.dyn, differed in 156 disassembly lines, and SIGSEGV'd the first exec'd guest process

kernel.build: GitHub Actions run 40535091305 (ubuntu x86_64, NDK r29 29.0.14206865, cross-compiled to aarch64-bionic)
kernel.source: Raymer8639/linux-um-arm64 (packaging fork), config = extracted guest config + CPUSETS + BLK_CGROUP + BLK_DEV_THROTTLING + MODULES

known_limits_observed: no CONFIG_MEMCG_KMEM: tmpfs/page cache uncharged, 80 MB tmpfs write inside a 64 MB group keeps memory.current at 0
io.max retest pending: root-cgroup probe is inconclusive, needs a child-cgroup check with +io in subtree_control
CPUSETS_V1 intentionally off (cgroup v2 cpuset is what matters)

observed.busybox_run: BUSYBOX_RUN_OK after a fresh pull through gvproxy NAT/DNS
observed.inbound_port: curl 127.0.0.1:8123 -> gvproxy-bess-ok with the web container up
observed.stale_initramfs_note: the graphdriver failure in the first full run came from the stale switch8 initramfs environment, not the kernel (cap10 dumped dockerd's log from the failed run)

notes: First kernel built entirely in CI (no device build needed) that boots and runs Docker on the device. Adopted as the 0.3.0 kernel. Build recipe: .github/workflows/kernel-build.yml; diagnostics in cap7-cap10 boot logs under workspace/uml-forensics/.
